genxml.title: TIO (NUMAlink I/O node ASIC of the Altix generation), as SGI's Linux platform code names its registers
genxml.doc: Offsets, field positions and constants are software definitions from SGI's Linux Altix platform code (header and driver, v5.3); the TIO's own register specification is not held. Only five registers are named by that code. Reset values are unknown throughout. Offsets are node offsets inside the TIO's address space, not CPU addresses.

struct.name: NODE_ID
struct.doc: Widget-format identification word of the TIO itself (`TIO_NODE_ID`). The kernel reads the whole 64-bit register, keeps the low 32 bits and splits them with the same macros it uses for every widget identification word: part number, revision, manufacturer. Its one use: the revision field decides whether the write-request flush workaround applies (revision 1).

struct.name: ICE_FRZ_CFG
struct.doc: ICE chiplet freeze configuration (`TIO_ICE_FRZ_CFG`). Bit 61 disables the conveyor of the FPGA port: the FPGA-port driver clears it to enable and sets it to disable, reading before writing and skipping the write when the bit is already right. Other bits are not read by any code.

struct.name: ITTE
struct.doc: Big-window translation table entries (`TIO_ITTE_BASE`, one entry per big window number 0 to 7). An entry maps one 1 GiB window of the TIO's address space onto a widget. The kernel defines a store macro (`TIO_ITTE_PUT`) and reads a firmware-held copy of the entries to find the widget for a window; no code read writes the register itself. The field positions are the macro's.

struct.name: ICE_PMI_TX_CFG
struct.doc: ICE port-module interface transmit configuration (`TIO_ICE_PMI_TX_CFG`). The FPGA-port driver resets corelet n by writing a one in bit n, waiting 2 ms, writing zero, then waiting 2 ms. The FPGA corelet is number 3.

struct.name: ICE_PMI_TX_DYN_CREDIT_STAT_CB3
struct.doc: Dynamic transmit credit status of channel buffer 3 (`TIO_ICE_PMI_TX_DYN_CREDIT_STAT_CB3`). The driver treats a credit count of 15 as proof that an FPGA bitstream is loaded and the port is running.
